title: Challenge 015 — how many outside-camera frames can disappear?
description: Measure the goalkeeper's tolerance to deterministic matched external-camera packet loss on a fresh shot suite. Every camera frame is rendered on time, assigned one precomputed per-shot loss score, and either delivered immediately or discarded. Higher loss conditions keep a strict subset of the frames kept at lower loss. The robot, physics, predictor, locomotion, shot generator, and scoring stay frozen.
frozen: zero delivery latency, prediction gain 1.0, and timestamp-aware forecast
shot generator and strict whole-ball goal scoring
